long_biography.plain_text:
Hotel executive Ivana Trump learnt to read building plans at her engineer father's kitchen table in Czechoslovakia. She later used that knowledge in property renovations. As president of New York's Plaza Hotel, she oversaw its refurbishment and recruited chef Alain Sailhac to improve a restaurant operation she considered unsatisfactory.

She also sought to make the Plaza a centre for fashion shows. Buyers and editors attending the seasonal collections had been travelling between scattered venues across Manhattan. Trump offered designers favourable rates to stage their shows at the hotel. About a dozen, including Oscar de la Renta, presented collections there during one autumn market.

uncertainties: Research date 1 October 2026; primary industry and relationship use the terminal lifetime point of 14 July 2022. The input Alive value is stale. Death fields are inapplicable in the immutable inventory, so the mortality correction is proposed and the exact death date retained as a manual candidate.

Creation Diversified is a material two-sector inference, not a default for missing evidence. The settlement transferred real-estate-derived wealth; own fashion earnings were separately substantial. Exact personal net proceeds and contribution weights are unverified.

Terminal property ranking comes from probate reporting and is corroborated by the will. Sole corporate ownership is positive personal ownership evidence. No ownership of all Trump-family business assets is implied, and children’s support payments are not treated as her capital.

Passive asset owner was tested against positive non-operating evidence, but testamentary executor appointments only begin after death. Historical founder and hotel operator roles cannot supply the missing terminal principal-asset relationship.

Every person-relevant profile type was checked: Instagram, LinkedIn, Facebook, Twitter/X, Youtube, Vimeo, Flickr, TikTok, Personal Website, Wikipedia and Forbes. Daughter Ivanka's accounts and third-party interviews/photos are excluded. The LinkedIn Touro College profile is a name-only mismatch. Company Website lacks a functioning verified subject business page; Trip Advisor and Zillow are not relevant here.

Facebook /theivanatrump is a plausible historical account but its current body and official attribution were not verifiable. The historical personal domain is inaccessible. Neither is proposed. No new personal accounts were authenticated.

Biography.com supplies middle name and corroborating birth details only; its premature death explanation and settlement aggregation are not imported. Deseret's contemporary operational reporting is separated from its unsupported Olympic and first-meeting anecdotes.

The licensed memoir and the TIME extract are the same underlying work; source budgets are treated conservatively. Commercial earnings are self-reported, not independently audited. UPI's entire indexed body was read after its direct page returned 403; no fact rests solely on a discovery snippet.

Birthplace is Zlin, then officially Gottwaldov, in Czechoslovakia. The current geographical country label Czech Republic is used, not a claim that this sovereign state existed at her birth. Other reported citizenships are withheld without equivalent primary support.

Minimum tag review distinguishes actual retail operations, recognised authorship and historical hotel leadership. No Olympic/skier, generic luxury, residential-investor, model or cosmetic subcategory tag is inferred from incidental exposure or unsupported claims.
